provenance: Compiled by the T1181 research subagent in a cloud session where no reference host could be fetched (Wikipedia, Wikidata, the ERA site and the national portals were refused by the egress proxy; only web search snippets were read). Label membership was cross-checked by search where possible; start points (2 decimals) are start towns or trailheads, not fetched, and 75 are null; source links were written, not opened. Facts only (name, aliases, countries, approximate start, length, kind, label); no descriptive text is copied. Verification against Wikidata and the portals is owner step T1181-a.

labels.lqt: ERA Leading Quality Trails, Best of Europe (partial: 11 of about 24)
labels.national_trail: official national trail status in its country (England and Wales National Trails, Scotland's Great Trails, Ireland National Waymarked Trails, SchweizMobil national routes and similar)
labels.quality_label: another national quality label (Top Trails of Germany, DWV Qualitaetsweg, DWI Premiumweg)
labels.wikipedia_list: on a Wikipedia list of long-distance or national trails, or an E-path
labels.famous_day: a well-known day walk with its own Wikipedia article (the walk or its landmark)

sources.name: Leading Quality Trails, Best of Europe
sources.publisher: European Ramblers Association (ERA/EWV/FERP); audits run by Deutscher Wanderverband Service GmbH
sources.lists: Certified LQT long-distance trails (about 24 to 25) with country, length, certification end year
sources.terms: No open licence found (site not reachable to read its terms). A list of trail names, countries and label status is factual and not copyrightable; store facts only with a citation.
sources.notes: Hosts www.era-ewv-ferp.org and era-ewv-ferp.org refused. Partial list confirmed only through WebSearch snippets; full list is an owner step.

sources.notes: Membership reconstructed from knowledge plus search; which certificate each trail holds was not verified.

sources.name: Deutsches Wanderinstitut Premiumwege
sources.notes: Not used beyond Top Trails membership (too many, mostly short loops).

sources.name: SchweizMobil Wanderland Schweiz national routes 1 to 7
sources.lists: 7 national, about 65 regional and about 290 local hiking routes
sources.terms: Route geometry is published on opendata.swiss (dataset langsamverkehr-wanderland-schweiz) under its stated terms; check the dataset licence before storing geometry. Names and numbers are factual.
sources.notes: Route numbers 1 and 7 confirmed by search (OSM wiki status page); 2 to 6 from knowledge. OSM relations for each route listed on wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Switzerland/HikingNetwork/Status (CC BY-SA 2.0).

curation_note: Edited after the first match run (T1181): generic codes removed as aliases because they name many trails (GR 5 on the Tour de la Vanoise, Madeira PR numbers, AV2) and the Tre Cime loop alias 'Drei Zinnen' replaced by the loop's names, since a hut named after the peaks is not the walk. Aliases added for two walks OSM names differently: 'Sentiero Verde Azzurro' (the Cinque Terre coastal path no. 2) and 'Terrasses de Lavaux' / 'Lavaux'. Proper names added as aliases where the reference had only a descriptive title (the walk's or the landmark's own name, never a generic word): Peddars Way, Norfolk Coast Path, Romsdalseggen, Glymur, Artemis Trail, Kjeragbolten, Kjerag, Triglav, Pyg Track, Via Alpina (Swiss route 1), Masca.
